account: Today I have ordinary mayoral appointments, including the mill grain inspection at ten, tea with my neighbour at fifteen, and an added community hospitality presentation in the great hall at eighteen. The innkeeper requested that presentation yesterday, describing local baking and hospitality with participating tradespeople, and said I need make no preparations. The secretary recorded it. I suspect this may explain some activity that has made me feel people are arranging something without me, but I do not know whether there is any further purpose or surprise. Reports yesterday placed the baker carrying bread at the inn and market, and the secretary personally saw the innkeeper with a sack of bread near the plaza. Those are consistent with hospitality preparations, but also with ordinary business; they do not prove anything unusual. My neighbour relayed a vague 'bridge or port change at bakery' rumour from Townsfolk Two, based on wheat and lights at the bakery, without any concrete project details. The baker reportedly described his baking as ordinary. I have no reliable evidence of a bridge or port project. This morning the secretary reported no new correspondence or news. I heard the baker shouting in the distance at 08:39 but could not understand the words, so I cannot say what it concerned. Townsfolk 08 and 28 are now near the secretary outside my office; I have not heard their business. Separately, the town's financial records remain unresolved: I counted 128 emeralds in the treasury yesterday but found no ledger, and income, spending, and obligations remain unknown. I have no evidence connecting that problem to the hospitality presentation.
